updateNote.en: This edition distinguishes choosing passages from ordering them and gives the question count for each comparison.
updateNote.zh: 本版分别说明段落选择与呈现顺序的作用，并标明各项比较的问题数。

en.title: Which change in the evidence changed the answer?
en.summary: How much of a gain comes from finding a better trio of passages, and how much from letting the model use fewer? Across 539 multi-hop questions, the option to use fewer passages accounts for 4.79 of Mistral’s 5.91 token-F1 points of improvement. In a separate 30-question comparison, changing the order of the same passages can reverse the apparent gain from choosing a new set.

zh.title: 是哪一步证据选择改变了回答？
zh.summary: 给模型更好的三段证据，和允许它少用几段，哪一步更有用？在 539 道多跳问题上，Mistral 的答案词元 F1 提高了 5.91 分，其中 4.79 分来自放宽段数限制。另取 30 道问题做交叉比较，同一组新证据换个排列顺序，得分变化的方向就可能翻转。

label.en: questions with a budget and search path
label.zh: 预算与搜索路径中的问题
有完整常规顺序答案的问题
同时测量两种顺序的问题

title.en: One question, the same two passages, a different band
title.zh: 同一道题、同两段证据，模型却答出了另一支乐队

en: Which band did the musician who would later sing for Devilment found? Qwen answers “Cradle of Filth” with the two selected passages in their original order. Swapping those passages changes the answer to “Falling in Reverse.” If the selector can choose passages again under the new order, Qwen returns to “Cradle of Filth.” A comparison of the first and last answers would record no change.
zh: 后来担任 Devilment 主唱的音乐人成立过哪支乐队？按原顺序读两段选中的证据，Qwen 答“Cradle of Filth”。把这两段对调，它改答“Falling in Reverse”。再允许选择器按新顺序重新选段，它又答回“Cradle of Filth”。只看首尾，会把这两次变化都漏掉。

caption.en: Figure 1. Read the saved Qwen answers from left to right. The first change reverses the same two passages. The second allows the selector to replace a passage under the reversed order.
caption.zh: 图 1。从左到右是 Qwen 实际生成的三个答案。第一步只对调原来的两段，第二步才允许选择器在反序条件下更换段落。

alt.en: Three saved answers to the Devilment question across changes in order and membership.
alt.zh: Devilment 问题在证据反序和重选前后的三次归档回答。

title.en: Separate the search for three passages from the option to use fewer
title.zh: 先比较怎样选三段，再比较能否少选

en: Start with six candidate passages. A greedy selector picks three, one at a time. An exhaustive selector scores every three-passage combination. Comparing the two measures what better search buys at the same size. The next step allows the exhaustive selector to choose zero, one or two passages as well. All selections use the reference answer’s likelihood. Token F1 measures the answer the generator actually produced.

The 539-question panel spans HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue, with two pool constructions for each question. The analysis averages the two tracks within question before estimating uncertainty. A nested panel of 89 questions has all 64 canonical subset answers for Qwen and Gemma. On 30 matched questions, each of the 42 sets of size at most three has an answer in both orders.
zh: 每道题给定六段候选。贪心法逐段选满三段，穷举法给每一种三段组合打分。先比较这两种选法，就能估计段数相同时搜索有多少用。然后只放宽段数，允许穷举法也选择零段、一段或两段。选段依据是参考答案的似然，最终得分则用模型实际回答的词元 F1 计算。
539 道题来自三个多跳问答基准，每题有两种候选池构造。统计先在同一问题内平均两条轨道，再估计不确定性。嵌套的 89 道题保存了 Qwen 和 Gemma 对全部 64 个子集的常规顺序回答。另有 30 道配对题，最多三段的 42 种组合均有两种顺序的回答。

title.en: Most of Mistral’s gain comes from the option to use fewer passages
title.zh: Mistral 的提升主要来自可以少选几段

en: Mistral gains 1.11 token-F1 points when exhaustive search replaces greedy selection at exactly three passages. Allowing shorter selections adds 4.79 points (paired 95% interval 3.12 to 6.53). The total gain is 5.91 points before the components are rounded. For Qwen and Gemma, the intervals for allowing fewer passages span both gains and losses.
zh: 固定选三段时，用穷举替代贪心，Mistral 提高 1.11 个词元 F1 分。允许少选后再提高 4.79 分，配对 95% 区间为 3.12 至 6.53 分。总增益为 5.91 分，各项数值分别四舍五入到小数点后两位。对 Qwen 和 Gemma，放宽段数的区间同时覆盖上升和下降。

caption.en: Paired changes in token F1 (points) on 539 questions. “Search” changes how a trio is chosen and “Budget” allows shorter sets. Each question contributes the mean of its two pools. Manuscript Table 2.
caption.zh: 539 道题的配对词元 F1 差值，单位为分。搜索项改变三段组合的选法，预算项允许选择更短的组合。每道题先取两个候选池的均值。见原稿表 2。

title.en: A new set of passages can help in one order and hurt in the other
title.zh: 同一组新段落带来的收益取决于排列顺序

en: On 30 matched questions with exactly three passages, reversing Gemma’s original selection costs 20.56 F1 points. With that reversed order fixed, choosing a new set recovers 16.54 points. Compare the very same old and new sets in the original order and the new set loses 23.35 points. The effect attributed to changing membership therefore depends on the order used for the comparison.

An answer-blind cross-encoder offers a check on a different selection objective. On the 89 retrieval-built pools, greedy and exact three-passage search choose identical sets in 75 cases. The observed answer changes still differ by generator. The size of the pool, the short-answer format and the single reversal bound the interpretation.
zh: 在固定三段的 30 道配对题上，只把 Gemma 原选的段落反序，答案 F1 就下降 20.56 分。保持反序再重新选段，可挽回 16.54 分。但把同一对新旧组合都按原顺序呈现，新组合反而低 23.35 分。判断换段是否有益，必须同时说明两组段落是按什么顺序读的。
另用无需参考答案的交叉编码器检查不同选择目标。在 89 个检索构造的池中，贪心与精确搜索有 75 次选中相同三段，实际答案变化仍因生成器而异。候选池大小、短答案形式及单一反序限定了结论的范围。

title.en: Trace an answer back to its selected passages
title.zh: 从归档回答追查当时选中的段落

en: The CPU replay checks 9,702 records that link a selected set to its generated answer, then recomputes 279 paired statistics. Passage IDs and text hashes identify the inputs in the source benchmarks. Use those benchmarks for the original passage text.

The original selection code independently finds masks 5 and 33 on the two saved utility surfaces for the Figure 1 question. The archived model loader, likelihood scorer and greedy generation routines are provided alongside it.
zh: CPU 回放先核对 9,702 条选段与生成回答的对应记录，再复算 279 项配对统计。可凭段落编号和文本哈希回到原始基准查阅正文。
用原始选择代码在图 1 问题的两个效用曲面上独立搜索，会分别得到掩码 5 和 33。包内同时提供当时的模型加载、似然评分与贪心生成实现。
